<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>BigoQueen</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,600;12..96,800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F6F3FF; --surface:#FFFFFF; --ink:#1F1A44; --muted:#5E5984; --line:#DCD6F2;
  --a:#FF7F9E; --b:#7FB6FF; --accent:#3B2FB5; --accent-ink:#FFFFFF; --live:#D2365B;
  color-scheme:light; box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#141029; --surface:#1E1840; --ink:#F2EFFF; --muted:#B0A9D6; --line:#352D66;
    --accent:#B9B0FF; --accent-ink:#17123A; --live:#FF8FA9; color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#141029; --surface:#1E1840; --ink:#F2EFFF; --muted:#B0A9D6; --line:#352D66;
  --accent:#B9B0FF; --accent-ink:#17123A; --live:#FF8FA9; color-scheme:dark;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{height:100%;background:var(--bg);scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;line-height:1.55;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit}
.bgphoto{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:var(--bg) url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") no-repeat 62% 20%/cover}
.bgscrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 92%,transparent) 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 70%,transparent) 38%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 18%,transparent) 100%)}

.in{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
a:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--a);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}

header .in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding-top:22px;padding-bottom:22px}
.brand{font-weight:800;font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none}
.logo{width:34px;height:22px;position:relative;display:inline-block}
.logo i{position:absolute;top:0;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.logo i:first-child{left:0;background:var(--a)}.logo i:last-child{right:0;background:var(--b)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .logo i{mix-blend-mode:screen}}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px;margin-left:auto;font-weight:600;font-size:.97rem}
nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted)}nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.btn{display:inline-block;font:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 20px;transition:transform .15s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.btn.lg{padding:16px 28px;font-size:1.08rem}

.hero{position:relative;padding:56px 0 88px}
.hero .in{position:relative}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface) 85%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:7px 16px;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;margin:0 0 22px}
.dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--live);animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5.6vw,4.4rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:15ch}
.lede{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:44ch;margin:0 0 30px}
.proof{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:28px 0 14px;font-weight:600}
.av{display:flex}
.av b,.who i{display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-weight:800;color:#1F1A44}
.av b{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--bg);margin-left:-10px;font-size:.9rem}
.av b:first-child{margin-left:0}
.av b:nth-child(1){background:var(--a)}.av b:nth-child(2){background:var(--b)}.av b:nth-child(3){background:#C6B8FF}
.trust{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.trust li::before{content:"\2713";color:var(--accent);font-weight:800;margin-right:8px}
.live{position:absolute;right:24px;bottom:-40px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--live)}

.solid{background:var(--bg);position:relative}
.alt{background:var(--surface)}
.stats{background:var(--surface);border-block:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.stats ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:34px 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;max-width:1080px;margin-inline:auto}
.stats strong{display:block;font-size:2.4rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:800}
.stats span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}

section.pad{padding:88px 0}
.kicker{display:inline-block;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin:0 0 10px}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 14px;max-width:20ch}
.intro{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.08rem;max-width:56ch;margin:0 0 44px}
.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0 56px}
.feat div{border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);padding:22px 0 30px}
h3{font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0 0 6px}
.feat p,.steps p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px;margin-bottom:44px}
.steps .n{display:block;font-size:3rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--a);line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px}
blockquote{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between}
blockquote p{margin:0;font-size:1.08rem}
.who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.who i{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--b)}
.who strong{display:block;line-height:1.2}.who span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.cta{text-align:center;padding:96px 0}
.cta h2,.cta .intro{margin-inline:auto}
.cta .intro{margin-bottom:28px}
.fine{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin:16px 0 0}

footer{background:var(--surface);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:56px 0 32px;position:relative}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px}
.cols p{color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 0;max-width:30ch}
footer h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1rem}
footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:8px}
footer ul a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}footer ul a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.legal{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:40px;padding-top:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
.legal p{margin:0 0 10px;max-width:90ch}

@media (max-width:820px){
  header .in{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 16px;padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:12px}
  header .btn{margin-left:auto}
  nav{order:3;width:100%;margin-left:0;overflow-x:auto;gap:20px}
  .hero{padding:28px 0 72px}
  .live{right:16px;bottom:-34px}
  .stats ul{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .feat,.steps,.quotes{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  section.pad{padding:60px 0}
  .in{padding:0 16px}
  .bgphoto{background-position:55% 15%}
  .bgscrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 82%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 40%,transparent))}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.dot{animation:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>
